title: Paint the Dungeon Red
description: Paint the Dungeon Red — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Kent the Artisan

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect the following things from enemies in Algernon

  • 7 cans of red paint, by killing Mutants and Haunts

Quest Reward: 750 Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to:Sir Kent the Artisan

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Paint by the Bucket

Last Build Updated: 155

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect 7 Buckets of Red Paint from the Searing Pincers, Burning Twins, Mutant Fire Belchers, and Fade Lava Lords. Afterward, return to Artisan Kent on Level 1 of Algernon.

Offer:

Ok, I only need one more type of paint for now: Red Paint. Really, it is the least you can do for me since I let you in my Monkeysphere. You can get the Buckets of Red Paint from the Mutants and the Fade Lava Lords here in Algernon, but be careful because these creatures are nothing to take lightly. And, take it from me, do not try to put them in a headlock. Have you ever had third degree burns on your armpit? I, um, had a, uh, friend that did that. It is neither pleasant nor tickling, much to my dismay...I mean my friend's dismay.

Collect the 7 Buckets of Red Paint from the Mutants and Lava Lords here in Algernon and return to me, Sir Kent the Artisan, here on the first level of Algernon.

Turn-in:

Thank you for gathering the Red Paint for me, Dungeon Runner. You have saved me a ton of time, energy, and sanity since I did not have to make a trip into Townston and interact with those cretins. Here is something for your troubles, minus a little Interaction Tax that I charge everyone that makes eye contact with me, let alone talk to me.

Objectives:

  • Red Paint ×7

Client level range: 3–20
